witness_description: The complete graph K_3 on vertices {0,1,2}, with respective weights (1,1,2), has the unique maximum weight independent set X={2}. The set Z={0,1} is a clique and X intersects Z in zero vertices.
refutation_explanation: K_3 is circular-arc because three identical nonempty arcs have pairwise-intersection graph K_3. Every nonempty independent set in K_3 is a singleton, and vertex 2 has weight 2 while vertices 0 and 1 each have weight 1, so X={2} is the unique maximum weight independent set. However, Z={0,1} is a clique and |X intersect Z|=0, not 1.
search_space: All 39 positively integer-weighted complete graphs K_n for 1 <= n <= 3, with labeled vertices 0,...,n-1 and weights in {1,2,3}; for each weighted graph, every vertex subset was checked for independence and maximum total weight, and every nonempty vertex subset was checked as a clique.
